faqs.q: What is the credit limit offered on Utkarsh SuperCard RuPay Card?
faqs.a: The credit limit for the Utkarsh SuperCard RuPay Credit Card is linked to the fixed deposit used as collateral. You can get up to 90% of your FD amount as the credit limit.

faqs.q: What cashback benefits does the card offer?
faqs.a: Utkarsh SuperCard RuPay offers 1% cashback on UPI and non-UPI transactions, 2% on Flipkart, and 5% on Myntra.

faqs.q: Are there any fees associated with this card?
faqs.a: Utkarsh SuperCard RuPay Credit Card has no joining or annual fees and is lifetime free. Standard charges include a finance charge of 3% per month on unpaid balances and late payment fees if bills are not cleared by the due date.
